$comment: The code-drawn app art: where scripts/art/render-app-art.ts writes each image (the production icons feed app-variants-and-environment's badged development and preview copies), which images may be absent, how much of an iOS icon the mark covers, and check-icons' allow-lists. Every key is optional; these are the defaults. An app that needs only the allow-lists keeps just the icons key: check-app-art then does not apply.
